checks: Read s36 output (out/s36_disk.txt) directly: Xb55 2-1 annuli R=0.575 (0-4"), 0.554 (4-8"), 0.489+-0.004 stat / +-0.028 bowl-corrected (8-12") reproduce the report. The go/no-go logic (Gaussian PB>=0.5, >3 sigma, bowl<30%) is sound and correctly leaves Xb4f/Xb4d/Xb47 beyond 8" as NO-GO (Xb4f 8-12" R=0.19, Xb47 negative flux). The round-1 0.30 is rightly withdrawn. Agree: the disk 2-1 ratio 0.49 is ~12% below the interior; this matches team-a p0004 (0.47-0.50 vs 0.56-0.62), an independent confirmation. It should stay 'medium/tentative' because the decrease is only ~2-3 sigma once the zero level is included and the same 8-12" annulus has resolve-out ordering in the continuum (0.41/0.27/0.27/0.14).

Nuclear ratios: the 3-2 N/S contrast (N 0.88-1.03, S 0.40-0.48, 6.5" blended 0.54/0.39, 10" midpoint 0.58/0.45/0.33 for 2-1/3-2/4-3) is consistent across Xb4b/Xb4d/Xb4f, between our code and team-a's independent native-beam code (S 0.40-0.41, N 0.83-0.90), and with team-b p0003 (<=9% array agreement). Conclusion 'no HCN/HCO+ enhancement at the AGN-hosting S nucleus, agreeing with Harada+2018' is well supported and conventions (matched beam, same pixel, +-350 km/s window, line-free baseline) are stated.

Deblend v2: chi2_red 9-99 means the model is approximate; the worker honestly inflates errors and adds a 15-25% S-vs-N injection bias. Deblended S/N~0.7+-0.2 at all J is consistent with team-a (S/N ~0.5-0.7) so the qualitative result (S<N at every J) does not depend on the deblend. Zone ladder T_b(2-1)/T_b(3-2)>1 and the absolute ladder slopes carry 10-35% cross-band systematics, as reported; I agree they should not be used for temperature claims.

Sblue wing: read out/s38_sblue2.txt. Null test (0/400 random positions with both wings >3 sigma), bright-position controls, posterior (R=1.40, 68% 1.12-1.79, P(R>1)=0.93) and injection (no peak-pixel bias) are the right calibration. The replication is weak (Xb4b smoothed 0.86+-0.25; Xb4f 0.83+-0.25) and team-a reports a full-window ratio 0.75+-0.06, so the conservative statement the worker makes (R_wing>R_core robust, R_wing>1 not established, tentative) is correct. Disagree only with leftover text (see fix 1).
RADEX consequence of each interpretation is derived (wing/core abundance factor 2.58 at equal excitation vs n 1e6->1e7 at fixed abundance): ambiguity is exploited, not ignored.

fixes.what: Edit the report text only (no new analysis): (a) remove 'team-a's 1.8 is biased high by peak selection' from the interpretation and use the injection-test wording (difference due to window/aperture; team-a's full-window 0.75+-0.06 is the same data with a core-dominated window); (b) merge the two duplicated Q1 passages in 'interpretation' into one consistent paragraph (R_wing 1.40, 68% 1.12-1.79, core 0.55; R_wing>R_core robust, R_wing>1 not replicated); (c) quote the disk 8-12" value uniformly as 0.489 +-0.004 stat, +-0.03 with bowl uncertainty, up to +-0.1 if the far-field zero level is mis-set, and mark the 12% decline as tentative; (d) cite team-a p0004 (agreement on N/S, disk 2-1, and the wing) in the Q1 entries.
fixes.why: A report that contradicts its own result entries and misattributes a bias to another team will mislead readers; the numbers themselves are fine.
fixes.how_experts_do_it: One consolidated results paragraph per claim with its calibrated significance, listing agreements and residual disagreements with other published work explicitly.

notes_for_questioner: (1) The compact HCN-bright N core (R rises 0.39 -> 0.97 inward, HCN/HCO+ peaks coincide with continuum to <=0.07") needs an opacity/HCN-vib test (HCN v2=1 at 4-3, H13CN, HNC) to separate abundance from excitation/IR pumping: hand to Q4. (2) The Sblue blob is the only enhancement candidate; the decisive test is the CO 3-2/2-1 wing association and a velocity-resolved ratio in the Xb4d data (Q3), not more Q1 aperture work. (3) Disk 3-2 and 4-3 ratios are not recoverable in the image plane; a statement of that, plus the 2-1 disk ratio, is the defensible deliverable. (4) HCN/HCO+ at the S nucleus being below N may be a beam/continuum-absorption effect: check for HCO+ self-absorption/continuum absorption at S (line profiles), which would bias R upward not downward, strengthening the 'no enhancement' conclusion.
